compilerIntervals.scope: Scoped Git-fixture/product/cmd tests, GOMAXPROCS=2 and -p=1; compiler outside observed driver family

limitations: This is a single-worker controlled mechanics run across four projects, not four concurrent live-model builds.
Sampling started after driver spawn; no pre-run idle Luci baseline was measured.
Summed process RSS includes shared pages and is not unique physical memory; role peaks are not simultaneous.
Guest container cgroup memory is separate from host process RSS; daemon/shared-kernel overhead is unassigned.
Host RAM/CPU/disk include unrelated activity and the disclosed compiler overlap; resource changes are not uniquely attributable to Luci.
Root and workspace are the same filesystem; do not add their free-space observations.
Seven initial samples lacked exact Docker ownership; short-lived processes and inter-sample events can be missed.
Process I/O was missing for some rows in21 samples; counter deltas cover observed intervals only.
The observed duration is below the10-minute controlled soak and30-minute native/live acceptance targets.
No native Windows, whole-computer responsiveness, UI input latency or live-model quality claim is established.
privacy: Allowlisted numerical fields and worker aliases only; original process/container/sandbox/team identities, local paths, auth, environment and raw errors are omitted.
